hero.title: Secure Your Legacy
hero.subtitle: Create and manage your will with confidence. Professional, secure, and accessible from anywhere.

multilingual.title: Multi-language
multilingual.description: English & Arabic with full RTL support.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.description: Sign up securely and verify your email.

step3.title: Get your draft
step3.description: We generate a draft PDF you can review.

q1.question: Is my information secure?
q1.answer: Yes. We use bank-level encryption and store all data securely with Supabase. Only you and authorized admins can access your information.

q2.question: Can I edit my will later?
q2.answer: Absolutely. You can log in anytime to update your details, beneficiaries, or assets. Changes will generate a new draft PDF.

q3.question: How is the draft generated?
q3.answer: Our system uses your submitted information to create a professionally formatted PDF draft. You can review it before finalizing.

q4.question: Do you support English and Arabic?
q4.answer: Yes. The entire interface supports both English and Arabic with full RTL (right-to-left) support for Arabic.

q5.question: Is e-signing supported?
q5.answer: Currently, we generate draft PDFs for your review. E-signing features are planned for future releases.

testimonials.trustNote: Trusted by clients in the UAE & UK
